added_entries.title: Dynamic-in-Few-Step: Unifying Dynamic Computation and Few-Step Distillation for Efficient Video Generation
added_entries.model: Wan-14B 4-step; variant not pinned in abstract
added_entries.mechanism: Joint stage-specific structured sparsification and few-step distillation yielding Mixture-of-Models with progressive training and output rollout
added_entries.risk: Closest four-step large Wan structural competitor; 24% per-step FLOP reduction, 1.2x extra wall are author numbers; does not identify intrinsic FFN neuron role

added_entries.title: FIS-DiT: Breaking the Few-Step Video Inference Barrier via Training-Free Frame Interleaved Sparsity
added_entries.mechanism: Interleaves latent frame subsets across model hierarchy; refreshes all frame positions across blocks despite partial-frame execution
added_entries.risk: Direct Wan2.2 few-step attention+FFN operator-agnostic competitor; does not show FFN channel sparsity; official code not yet publicly located in host repo

added_entries.title: PARE: Pruning and Adaptive Routing for Efficient Video Generation
added_entries.mechanism: Motion-aware attention-head width pruning plus learned per-step/content-conditioned block router
added_entries.action: pruned attention width and dynamically skipped blocks
added_entries.risk: Strong adaptive-depth competitor on I2V Wan; attention head widths not FFN channels; routing training/nontrivial overhead

added_entries.title: Taming Diffusion Transformer for Efficient Mobile Video Generation in Seconds
added_entries.mechanism: KD-guided tri-level block/head/FFN-channel sensitivity pruning with adversarial 4-step distillation and compressed VAE
added_entries.action: physically smaller FFN width and blocks
added_entries.risk: The closest true FFN-channel structural pruning baseline, but multi-part mobile speed cannot be attributed to FFN alone

added_entries.title: FastLightGen: Fast and Light Video Generation with Fewer Steps and Parameters
added_entries.mechanism: Rank non-critical blocks, probabilistic dynamic pruning then joint size-step distribution distillation
added_entries.action: block-depth pruning and fewer denoise steps
added_entries.risk: 4-step/30% pruning includes block+step changes; do not infer F1 FFN selective neuron redundancy

added_entries.title: Forecast the Principal, Stabilize the Residual (SVD-Cache)
added_entries.mechanism: Principal subspace smooth and predictable but low-energy residual temporally oscillatory; EMA principal, cache residual
added_entries.risk: Competes directly with any claim that low-energy FFN modes can be omitted without temporal consequence; announced GitHub repo essentially empty in checked snapshot

added_entries.title: ProCache: Constraint-Aware Feature Caching with Selective Computation for DiT
added_entries.mechanism: Offline constrained heterogeneous cache schedule plus selective computation in important deep blocks/tokens
added_entries.risk: Deep-block restoration not FFN function selectivity; near competitor to function-dependent compute schedule

added_entries.title: BLADE: Block-Sparse Attention Meets Step Distillation for Efficient Video Generation
added_entries.mechanism: Content-aware adaptive block sparse attention integrated during step distillation
added_entries.risk: Strong joint optimization precedent on Wan1.3B but attention is not FFN; speed relative to 50-step cannot be cited as extra per-step gain

added_entries.title: Veda: Scalable Video Diffusion via Distilled Sparse Attention
added_entries.mechanism: Attention quality governed by matched full-attention tile geometry; tile scoring/head-aware tiling and sparse tile kernel
added_entries.risk: Tile shape→quality observation is an analog, not evidence FFN Fourier modes define valuable compute

added_entries.title: Pluggable Pruning with Contiguous Layer Distillation (PPCL)
added_entries.mechanism: Find contiguous redundant layers via linear probing; teacher/student alternating distillation for depth and width in one phase
added_entries.action: width and contiguous depth physical pruning
added_entries.risk: Requires trained recovery and mostly images, not original Wan FFN sparse conditional functions

added_entries.title: Neodragon: Mobile Video Generation Using Diffusion Transformer
added_entries.mechanism: Block pruning plus text encoder/VAE compression and extended DMD step distillation
added_entries.action: whole-block cut + step count, compressed VAE
added_entries.risk: Mobile full pipeline can hide FFN-specific cost and temporal texture impact

added_entries.title: Test-time Sparsity for Extreme Fast Action Diffusion
added_entries.mechanism: Runtime predictor for prunable residual compute with reused previous step and rollout features; parallel overlap to amortize selector cost
added_entries.risk: Strong information-timing and predictor-cost neighbor, but action policy data/costs not Wan video quality

added_entries.title: Transition Matching Distillation for Fast Video Generation
added_entries.mechanism: Decompose backbone early semantic extractor and final flow head with inner rollout; distribution matching of transitions
added_entries.action: less repeated backbone, conditional flow head
added_entries.risk: Functional layer roles and suffix dependencies are relevant but this is architecture/step repurposing, not FFN neuron sparsity

added_entries.title: Adaptive Video Distillation: Mitigating Oversaturation and Temporal Collapse
added_entries.mechanism: Adaptive regression and explicit temporal regularization to prevent few-step low-dynamic quality
added_entries.training: DMD with regularization and optional SFT
added_entries.risk: Provides explicit quality failure mode competing with FFN local error explanation; no direct sparse FFN mechanism

added_entries.title: Attention Surgery: An Efficient Recipe to Linearize Your Video Diffusion Transformer
added_entries.mechanism: Hybrid linear+softmax attention with layer rate selected by physical cost and lightweight distillation
added_entries.risk: Shows functional decomposition into distinct operators, not proof FFN GELU splits analogously

added_entries.title: SPRINT: Sparse–Dense Residual Fusion for Efficient DiT
added_entries.mechanism: Shallow dense detail plus deep sparse tokens fused by residual; train sparse then restore full tokens; PDG inference
added_entries.action: sparse deep blocks and residual fusion
added_entries.risk: Training-time token structure and inference guidance differ from Wan sparse FFN; motivates preserving context via dense/sparse paths

added_entries.title: NerVE: Nonlinear Eigenspectrum Dynamics in LLM Feed-Forward Networks
added_entries.mechanism: GELU and other FFN nonlinearities reinject variance across eigendirections; spectral entropy and effective dimension shift
added_entries.risk: Actual FFN nonlinearity changes function rank; cov-spectrum is diagnostic, not feature causality or an online sparse decision

added_entries.title: CineMobile: On-Device I2V Diffusion for Cinematic Camera Motion
added_entries.mechanism: Distillation-guided structured depth pruning, four-step DMD+RL and mixed W4A16/FP8 precision
added_entries.action: pruned blocks, four-step sampler and 4bit FFN weights
added_entries.risk: FFN W4 weight precision is not W4A4 and not FFN arithmetic sparsity; author system-level 40x not isolate FFN
